attchmntText: Pearl Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Pearl Polymers Limited has published its financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The publication was released in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers on November 14, 2026. This filing is submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The document serves as a notice of publication for the approved financial data.

attchmntText: Pearl Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pearl Polymers Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:10 p.m. and concluded at 04:45 p.m. The company enclosed the Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors Goel Goyal And Co. The auditors confirmed that the statement was prepared in accordance with applicable Accounting Standards and Listing Regulations, with no material misstatements identified. The stock codes are PEARLPOLY for the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and 523260 for BSE Limited. The company requested the exchanges to take the information on record.
